review.medical_review: pending independent pediatric cardiology/board-review SME review
review.item_writer_review: AI editorial rebuild completed; human item-writer review pending
review.technical_validation: automated schema/UI validation configured; current revision requires CI verification before publication
review.publication_rule: Do not mark published or merge to production solely on automated review.

rendering.exam_mode: Hide correct_option_id, rationale, option_explanations, board_pearl, evidence, concept, learning_objective, cognitive_level, difficulty, and review metadata until grading.
rendering.option_shuffling_rule: Shuffle option objects at render time. Assign displayed A-E labels only after shuffling. The stored correct answer is a stable option id, never a canonical letter.
rendering.grading_mode: Show the correct displayed option, overall rationale, explanation for every choice, board pearl, concept, learning objective, cognitive level, difficulty, and evidence tags.
rendering.stacking: Serve exactly 10 questions at a time unless a caller explicitly requests another count.
rendering.assessment_security: Client-side answer concealment is for self-study only and is not a secure examination environment.

schema.age: patient age as presented in the vignette
schema.learning_objective: specific observable decision or distinction being tested
schema.stem: clinical vignette plus a single best-answer lead-in
schema.options: array of exactly five objects with stable id and text
schema.correct_option_id: stable option id; UI assigns A-E only after shuffle
schema.rationale: why the correct answer is best in this vignette
schema.option_explanations: object keyed by option id; each explanation addresses why the choice may be tempting, why it is or is not best, and when relevant when it would be appropriate
schema.evidence: array of claim/source_id mappings resolved in sources.json

stacks.focus: heart failure, shock, disposition, and mechanical support
recovery, follow-up, sports, recurrence, and integration

authoring_rules: Every question must require at least two clinically relevant data points unless intentionally foundational.
Distractors must be clinically plausible alternatives or management errors for a pediatric resident; unrelated throwaway options are prohibited.
No two questions in the bank may test the same learning objective with only superficial changes in age or wording.
General-pediatrics decisions take priority over advanced subspecialty procedure details.
Time-sensitive recommendations must identify the guideline/source context rather than imply timeless certainty.
